findings.title: Client bedrock fail-fast ignores bedrock-agentcore URLs
findings.problem: A2AClient.__init__ raises only when agent_card.bedrock_agentcore is truthy, and the card resolver no longer sets that flag. A client built with a bedrock-agentcore url= override, or from a card whose JSONRPC interface URL is a bedrock-agentcore URL, does not raise. Spec R10 and the AC require a clear unsupported error for bedrock-agentcore URLs in the client.
findings.impact: Bedrock AgentCore endpoints are reached with the v1.0 client and fail obscurely at request time instead of with the intended unsupported error; spec requirement R10 is only partly met.
findings.recommendation: After resolving self.url, raise ValueError('Bedrock AgentCore (A2A v0.3) is not supported') when the resolved URL's hostname contains bedrock-agentcore, in addition to the card flag; add a client test for the url= override path.

findings.title: Stream frame validation errors escape untyped
findings.problem: send_task_streaming catches only json.JSONDecodeError and httpx.RequestError. A pydantic ValidationError from _parse_stream_result (e.g. an enveloped frame with an unhandled key such as task or message) and httpx_sse.SSEError (non-SSE content type) propagate raw. Reachability of these paths against a live server was not confirmed.
findings.impact: Callers that handle A2AClientJSONError/A2AClientHTTPError miss these failures and the stream aborts with an unclassified exception.
findings.recommendation: except (ValidationError, SSEError) as e: raise A2AClientJSONError(str(e)) from e, and consider handling task/message envelope keys in _parse_stream_result.

findings.title: BedrockAdapter still referenced in src
findings.problem: The version.py docstring still names BedrockAdapter, while the AC requires no references to BedrockAdapter to remain in src/.
findings.impact: Acceptance criterion is literally unmet and the docstring points to a removed class.
findings.recommendation: Reword the docstring to drop the BedrockAdapter reference.
